summary: Ares Industrial Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to provide an updated net asset value (NAV) per share as of June 30, 2026. The August 1, 2026 transaction price equals each share class's NAV per share. The board adopted valuation procedures and engaged Altus Group U.S. Inc. as independent valuation advisor to appraise real properties and certain debt-related assets monthly and review third-party appraisals. The filing includes a table comparing aggregate Fund NAV components for June 30 and May 31, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed; this is a routine monthly NAV update for a non-traded REIT.
